questions.question: Verify whether the Poincaré–Birkhoff–Witt theorem belongs in George David Birkhoff’s biography.

localizations.source: Verify whether the Poincaré–Birkhoff–Witt theorem belongs in George David Birkhoff’s biography.
localizations.ru: Проверить, относится ли теорема Пуанкаре — Биркгофа — Уитта к биографии Джорджа Дэвида Биркгофа.

questions.resolution: The PBW paragraph and digest reference were removed: the relevant Birkhoff is George David Birkhoff’s son Garrett Birkhoff, whose independent proof appeared in 1937. Sources: https://www.numdam.org/articles/10.24033/rhm.89/ ; https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/abs/commutative-algebra-and-noncommutative-algebraic-geometry/poincarebirkhoffwitt-theorems/BAB26249011D02C7E3FC1CEFAF647AE2
